en.html:
Akima"..."
Muramasa I"...One arrow, straight through the heartsteel's core. The man has rotted completely; only the skill is still fresh, Akima saab."
Akima"Yes."
Muramasa I"Did you not come in support of this warrior?"
Akima"I did."
Muramasa I"...Changing sides?"
Akima"The situation has turned again. Sasaki has gone over to Yoshino with Tanba's local forces... Now in the Kinki region the Southern Court will recover."
Akima"This one's head I decided to take as my gift, and ask the Southern Court to let me return."
Muramasa I"Sharam nahin aati, Akima! Not a scrap of shame!"
Akima"..."
Muramasa I"Your loyalty is this cheap?! Two-paisa man... is that all you were!!"
Akima"...Loyalty."
Akima"Until that day, myself also I believed I was a loyal retainer. Bad fortune in battle, defeat, death—I could accept those. But bowing to the enemy just to keep living, never..."
Akima"But that day... the Northern Court's great army came toward Nagashima. I understood: let them surround us and the whole clan is finished. At that very instant—"
Akima"Like frost melting, all at once loyalty's worth went out of my understanding... For this, I should throw away myself and my whole clan? Was that really right?"
Akima"...Forgive me. My loyalty, it seems, was only this much. Counterfeit goods."

飽間「……」
始祖村正「……心鉄の軸を一矢で射抜くか。 　性根は腐り果てても、腕は昔のままのよう だな。飽間様」
飽間「ああ」
始祖村正「あなたはこの武者の後詰として来たのでは ないのか？」
飽間「そうだ」
始祖村正「……寝返りか」
飽間「情勢がまた変わったのでな。 　佐々木が丹波の國衆くにしゅうを連れて吉野に転んだ ……今後、畿内では南朝が盛り返す」
飽間「こやつの首を手土産に、南朝へ帰参を願う ことにした」
始祖村正「恥じぬか、飽間！」
飽間「……」
始祖村正「なれの忠義はそんなにも安いのか！ 　そこまで……下らぬ男だったのかっ!!」
飽間「……忠義か」
飽間「あの時までは、わしも己を忠臣だと信じて おった。 　武運つたなく敗れ死すことはあろうとも、 敵に屈して生き長らえはすまい、とな……」
飽間「だがあの時……北朝の大軍が長島に迫り。 　囲まれたが最後、一門全滅は避けられぬと 悟った刹那」
飽間「ふっと、霜が溶けるように、忠義なるもの の値打ちがわからなくなってしもうた……。 　我が身と一族をそのために擲なげうって、本当に 良いのか……と」
飽間「……済まぬな。 　わしの忠義とはその程度……紛い物でしか なかったようだ」

Muramasa I"..."
Muramasa I"Traitor... Traitor..."
Muramasa I"Traitor!!"
Akima"..."
Akima"About me, say what you like. But Muramasa, your wife—don't hate her."
Akima"She had no choice..."
Muramasa I"What 'no choice'! Captured by the enemy—fine, I won't say she should have killed herself. But some principle, one line she should have refused to cross!"
Muramasa I"A tsurugi she forges and gifts to the enemy!? That one... no wife of mine, no family of mine anymore!!"
Akima"...Muramasa. Your wife—"
Akima"After the Northern Court took her prisoner, they forced her to marry another Emishi and bear a child."
Muramasa I"————"
Akima"Then they held that child over her. Forge a tsurugi, they said, if you want the child to live."
Akima"The child before her, or the family far away... After her anguish, your wife made her own body iron."
Akima"...Do not resent her..."
Muramasa I".............."
